input.quote: 16.5 On request or termination, the recipient shall return or destroy Confidential Information, subject to routine backups and legal retention. Duties for trade secrets continue while protected as trade secrets; duties for other Confidential Information continue for five years after disclosure. Customer Data remains governed by Sections 11 and 15.
input.rationale: No exit clause exists anywhere in this hosted-services MSA. Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination) deals only with access cut-off "after any agreed transition period" (10.1) and Deliverable delivery and refunds (10.2); it creates no transition-assistance obligation and no obligation to return or export Customer Data. Section 16.5 carves Customer Data out of the confidentiality return/destroy duty and defers it to "Sections 11 and 15", but the Agreement contains no Section 11 and Section 15 only limits processing and allocates privacy compliance (15.1-15.2) without any return, export, deletion or certification duty. Searches for transition, export, return and delete confirm the gap. We therefore insert a single new Section 10.3 at the preferred position: transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter. We separately note (not redlined here) that the cross-reference in Section 16.5 to "Sections 11 and 15" is broken and should point to the new Section 10.3.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 10.3 requiring transition assistance, Customer Data return in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 addresses only access cut-off, Deliverables and refunds, and no clause anywhere requires our data back or exit help, so we add transition assistance for up to six months at your then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter. If helpful, we can fall back to ninety days of assistance with the same thirty-day export.

ops.text: On expiry or termination of this Agreement or an Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty days after that expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard, commonly used machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems and certify that deletion to Customer in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
